results.title: Antarvasna
results.overview: A middle-aged housewife and mother of a 12 year old kid struggles to find time for herself to manage between unending housework and a regular ignorant husband.

results.title: Gondhal
results.overview: Suman, a newly-wedded wife in Maharashtra's Gondhal rituals, conspires with Gondhali Saheba to kill her husband, Anand. They plan to carry out an escape that jeopardises her soul amid drum-driven ritual and divine omens, blurring the distinction between salvation and damnation in a citywide verdict of fire, blood, and awe.

results.title: The Disciple
results.overview: Self-doubt, sacrifice and struggle converge into an existential crisis for a devoted classical vocalist as the mastery he strives for remains elusive.

results.title: Ashleel Udyog Mitra Mandal
results.overview: When the epitome of female sexuality, the iconic Savita Bhabhi, comes in 21-year-old Aatish's dreams, he invites her to be the chief guest of the local Dahi Handi festival. Aatish, spellbound by the magical lady who has seen it all, drives himself and those around him into a state of frenzy.

results.title: Natsamrat
results.overview: A veteran Shakespearean actor steps off the stage and into the painful tragedy of old age, facing ungrateful family and his fleeting legacy.  Based on a play of the same name written by playwright Kusumagraj (V. V. Shirwadkar).

results.title: Jayanti 2
results.overview: When a tribal girl, Payal, is suspended from college for protesting discrimination by her classmates, Santya and Tanuja team up to fight college politics, political pressure, and social ignorance in order to restore her dignity and secure her return.

results.title: Bandkhor
results.overview: Six women from different backgrounds unite to challenge societal expectations. Bandkhor chronicles their journeys toward dignity and freedom as they reclaim their lives and forge their own paths through courage and determination.

results.title: Bucket List
results.overview: 'Bucket List' is a story of a woman trapped in the confines of her own choices and her journey to self discovery. Madhura Sane is a 40 y.o housewife (by choice) belonging to a quintessential middle/upper middle class family in Pune. One fine day, through a chance encounter, Madhura comes face to face with a choice that could potentially change her whole life. And that choice involves...a Bucket List.

results.title: Raja Shivaji
results.overview: Chronicles the rise of young Shivaji Bhonsale, who challenged the might of established empires to found the Maratha kingdom and lay the groundwork for 'Swarajya' (self-rule) during a turbulent period of Indian history.

results.title: Nay Varan Bhat Loncha Kon Nai Koncha
results.original_title: Nay Varan Bhat Loncha Kon Nai Koncha
results.overview: This movie is a brutal look at coming of age in a city whose citizens have been famished by brutality and sin for centuries. It is said that the night sky of Mumbai has been forever haunted - hiding the beautiful twinkling stars by the curse of countless lives lost in a ruthlessly expanding city. The film, soaked in the fog of these ancestors, explores what it takes to grow up in a deprived community, looking to satiate the hunger of one's soul. Enacted by two young souls, The film is a director's masterpiece.

results.title: Magazine
results.overview: Bored, privileged, and convinced his life has zero plot, a drama-hungry Gen Z cinephile leaves the city for his ancestral village in search of some main-character energy, hoping life will finally give him something worth talking about, but an unlikely friendship, a new world, and one unexpected twist soon turn his own life into the story he's been waiting for.

results.title: Baban
results.overview: In an endeavor to convert the traditional business into a big one, ambitious Baban strives hard to fulfill his dreams of prosperity, but the circumstances lead him elsewhere, which in-turn gives rise to a storm.

results.title: Half Ticket
results.overview: Two young slum brothers are fascinated with the arrival of a new pizza shop in their locality, but getting in is harder than they thought.

results.title: Kharvas
results.overview: After losing her baby in a failed delivery(still birth), Aasawari withdraws to her ancestral home in a remote konkan village. Her struggle to overcome this tragic trauma is met with ultimate provocation when she accidentally learns about, a pregnant cow due to deliver, in their own cowshed.

results.title: MANJAR
results.overview: A youthful Marathi family entertainer about friendship, love, family relationships and the unpredictable situations of everyday life, seen through the amusing perspective of an observant cat.

results.title: Abhanga Tukaram
results.overview: Abhanga Tukaram based on the Abhanga saga of Saint Tukaram Maharaj A rich collection of saintly literature on the silver screen. Maharashtra has been enriched by the thought of saints. The Abhangagatha of Jagadguru Sant Shrestha Tukaram Maharaj is a very valuable treasure in Marathi literature.

results.title: Holy Crime
results.overview: A celebrated melodrama. A bank employee who steals money to buy medicine for his dying wife is caught, jailed and dies of shame.

results.title: Cactus Pears
results.overview: Anand, a 30-something city dweller compelled to spend a 10-day mourning period for his father in the rugged countryside of western India, tenderly bonds with a local farmer who is struggling to stay unmarried. As the mourning ends, forcing his return, Anand must decide the fate of his relationship born under duress.

results.title: Court
results.overview: A sewerage worker's dead body is found inside a manhole in Mumbai. An ageing folk singer is tried in court on charges of abetment of suicide. He is accused of performing an inflammatory song which might have incited the worker to commit the act. As the trial unfolds, the personal lives of the lawyers and the judge involved in the case are observed outside the court.
